entity_name: Odbor za vansudsko rješavanje potrošačkih sporova
source_name: Odbor za vansudsko rješavanje potrošačkih sporova (Privredna komora Crne Gore)
why_relevant: Functionally independent consumer ADR body at the Chamber of Commerce, identified by CBCG as the out-of-court route for financial-services disputes. Its case summaries are a second, non-regulator stream of consumer-complaint evidence about banks' payment and card operations.

source_name: MONSTAT public-procurement contract documents (example of buyer-side self-publication)
why_relevant: Demonstrates a persistent ME pattern: individual contracting authorities also self-publish award decisions (Obrazac 18 / odluka o izboru) as PDFs on their own sites, sometimes with documents that are hard to locate on CeJN. Worth a standing sweep across state-body domains for /javne nabavke/ugovori/ directories.

source_name: Unija poslodavaca Crne Gore (Montenegrin Employers Federation) - studies on access to finance
why_relevant: Business-association commissioned studies on access to finance survey banks and SMEs, frequently produced with consultancy support; they profile bank product/channel capability from the demand side and identify the local consulting firms doing sector research.

source_name: Adria TV Portal — regional (Adriatic) news portal, economy section
why_relevant: Adriatic-framed outlet that carried Montenegrin instant-payments coverage; representative of the regional-media layer where ME payments-infrastructure milestones are reported for a cross-border audience.

Long-established ME product development partner (strategy/design/development) and ICT Cortex member; a likely supplier of digital front-ends (mobile/web banking UX) even where the core system is foreign. Its work/portfolio page is the place to test that hypothesis.

entity_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering Montenegro + IFI notices
source_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering Montenegro + IFI notices (javne-nabavke.com, eKapija tenderi)
why_relevant: Regional aggregators monitor CEJN plus additional channels including donor/IFI notices, and index them in Serbian/Montenegrin. Useful as a cross-check that no supranational notice with a ME beneficiary was missed, and for local-language phrasing of tender subjects.

source_name: Credit rating agencies - sovereign and bank reports touching Montenegro (Moody's, S&P, Fitch)
why_relevant: Rating agency bank/sovereign reports and rating-action commentaries on Montenegro and on parent groups with ME subsidiaries (OTP, NLB, Erste, Addiko, Ziraat) discuss franchise digitalisation, cost-to-income and IT investment as rating drivers - competitor context that vendors never publish.

Global aggregator with a Montenegro country page and separate government-tender view; sector filters allow banking/IT slicing and it also indexes IFI-funded notices. Redundancy and cross-check source rather than a primary one.
Classifieds board IT-jobs section; catches informal/contractor postings (e.g. ATM field service, POS technician) that reveal who services which bank's estate.

source_name: Montenegro Business Alliance (Montenegro Biznis Alijansa, MBA)
why_relevant: Private-sector advocacy alliance claiming 500+ companies and ~40% of GDP; useful as a second, non-chamber roster of corporate buyers and as a barrier/regulation-reform voice. No live own-domain directory located, so profiled via third-party registries.

source_name: Montenegrobusiness / monte.business — English-language ME payments coverage
why_relevant: English-language secondary coverage of ME payment infrastructure events (TIPS Clone signing, instant payments readiness). Lower authority but useful for quickly surfacing events to non-Montenegrin-reading analysts and for cross-checking dates.

source_name: MontenegroTenders.com — country tender database with alerts
why_relevant: Commercial English-language database claiming daily-updated coverage of Montenegrin tenders and contracts. Useful as a redundancy layer and for English-side searchability of notices that are only issued in Montenegrin; coverage of genuinely private bank tenders is unproven and should be tested before purchase.
Example of an international PSP marketing cross-border acceptance into ME; such country pages enumerate locally relevant methods and signal foreign competitive pressure on local acquirers.
Secondary ME job board with an IT vertical; useful for redundancy since smaller vendors and integrators sometimes post only here.

Northern-Montenegro regional outlet; carried the same 'Partnerstvo koje pokreće uspjeh' partnership piece as CdM, illustrating that bank PR/partnership copy is syndicated across small regional portals. Useful for detecting the PR distribution footprint of a vendor or bank campaign.

ME software house for accounting/SME systems. Relevant to this cell as the integration layer between merchant accounting, fiscalisation and bank payment files (payment order import/export, statement formats) - a low-visibility but real part of the ME payments software chain.
Another global procurement-intelligence platform indexing Montenegro and EBRD notices; offers a free tier useful for low-cost cross-verification that a notice found elsewhere is real and current.
